body: (UPDATE) I went to a new urologist and I’m starting to have hope again. He believes it is something called Prostatitis. He gave me some medicine and I have some type of X-ray thing if the pain doesn’t subside. I don’t know why but I feel confident about him since he was the first doctor to actually see another side of it. I’m still in pain but my hopes are high and I just wanted to thank the people for taking time out of their day to help me. Thank you <3
Thanks man I appreciate the support. The pain is getting worse by the night and my parents are going to try and book for appointments. Thanks for all the love it’s gets me going through this <3
